cases.receiver_vs_free: A receiver call c.configure() targets the method; the bare configure() targets the same-named free function. The two must stay distinct.
cases.self_call: this/self method call inside the class resolves to the sibling method.
cases.cross_file: Calls to functions defined in another file of the project.
cases.external_collision: shutdown() calls an external API whose name collides with a project symbol (console.log / logging.log / Logger.log / time.Format / std::fmt::format). It must produce no edge.
cases.assignment_receiver: let c: Client = ...; and let w = Worker::new(): a let's annotation, or a `Type::new()` constructor, types the binding.
cases.field_type: self.c.configure(): the struct field's declared type types self.c.
cases.return_type: let c = make(); and make().configure(): the function's return type types the result.
